description: Flux Control is a workflow automation and process-management platform built on pipes (workflows), stages, and cards. Its tools let users browse and manage pipes, stages, and cards; assign members, add labels, and post comments; move cards across stages; run reviews and approvals; and manage templates, forms, databases, automations, roles, teams, and delegations - all within their private, multi-tenant workspace.

defaultPrompt: Show me the cards in my Sales pipeline and summarize which ones are stuck.
List the approvals and reviews waiting on me.
Help me create a new pipe for my sales team!
